publishedfiledetails.description:
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/14783242143448881515/7E649188A839034944A2ABB2F47EAE25613A7A2C/[/img]

[h1]Historic Samara 2[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Bring the atmosphere of old Samara to your republic.

Merchant houses with decorative stucco, red-brick façades and historic shopfronts bring the character of the old city to your streets. The residential buildings are joined by a pelmeni restaurant on Frunze Street, Furor Cinema and the wooden Church of St Mitrofan of Voronezh.

This second collection includes 12 buildings for Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic: 9 residential houses for 408 residents, a restaurant, a cinema and a church.

[h1]Residential buildings[/h1]
[list]
[*]House with a Doughnut Shop at 101 Frunze Street - 16 residents. Housing quality: 88%.
[*]Historic House at 95 Kuybysheva Street - 96 residents. Housing quality: 89%.
[*]House at 68 Kuybysheva Street - 96 residents. Housing quality: 88%.
[*]House with a Tobacco Shop at 94 Kuybysheva Street - 24 residents. Housing quality: 89%.
[*]House at 82 Molodogvardeyskaya Street - 24 residents. Housing quality: 89%.
[*]House at 85 Sadovaya Street - 48 residents. Housing quality: 89%.
[*]House at 71 Lev Tolstoy Street - 16 residents. Housing quality: 88%.
[*]House at 83 Lev Tolstoy Street - 48 residents. Housing quality: 88%.
[*]Corner House at 35 Ventseka Street / 53 Stepana Razina Street - 40 residents. Housing quality: 84%.
[/list]

[h1]Restaurant, cinema and church[/h1]
[list]
[*]Historic Pelmeni Restaurant at 103 Frunze Street - 5 jobs; capacity: 30 visitors.
[*]Furor Cinema at 231 Sadovaya Street - 15 jobs; capacity: 120 visitors. Base rating: 3.2.
[*]Church of St Mitrofan of Voronezh - 4 jobs: 2 workers and 2 university-educated specialists; capacity: 120 visitors.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Created by Mark Grayson.

publishedfiledetails.title: Metrostroy rail borer - Early start 1934
publishedfiledetails.description:
Early Start Metrostroy Rail Borer

The Metrostroy Rail Borer is a Soviet railway mounted tunneling machine used during the construction of the Moscow Metro.

For gameplay balance, this mod features 50% of the working performance of the vanilla rail borer, offering an early start, slower approach to tunnel construction.

In-Game Specifications:

Yeah: 1934

Maximum Speed: 30 km/h

Working Speed: 130

Working Performance: 50% of the vanilla rail borer

publishedfiledetails.title: Kaengsaeng 68
publishedfiledetails.description:
The Kaengsaeng 68 is a copy of the Soviet GAZ-69 produced in North Korea. The Kaengsaeng 68 served as the main light off-road vehicle of the Korean People's Army for decades as well as being used for various civilian purposes. In addition to the basic 2 and 4 door bodies, truck versions have also been produced. Mechanically it is similar to the GAZ-69, with the major difference being a simplified drivetrain, completely omitting the driven front axle. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZxR4kiP.jpeg[/img]
